svg.title: Example: Daily Sync
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape daily sync board: the goal, ground rules, a walk-the-board area read right to left, questions to ask, blockers and swarms, a parking lot, and a weekly sync health check.
svg.text: A short daily check on progress toward the goal: walk the board, raise blockers, and plan the day together.
Run Events · Daily Scrum · Stand-up · Kanban Meeting · 15 Minutes
Sprint goal, iteration goal, or the outcome the team is focused on this week
For the team, not a status report
Details go to the parking lot
RIGHT TO LEFT · FINISH BEFORE YOU START
What's nearly done, and what's needed to finish it?
What's blocked or getting old? Who can help?
Only then: what should we start?
ABOUT THE WORK, NOT THE PEOPLE
For each item on the board
Is it older than our SLE?
What did I do yesterday toward the goal?
What will I do today toward the goal?
Do I see anything in the way?
Useful, but easily becomes a status report.
The Scrum Guide no longer requires them.
Topics that need more than a minute
Talked about the goal, not just activity
Oldest and blocked items discussed first
We know what we'll finish today
If a check fails, we'll try:
“Who needs help, and who can give it?”
Run Events · Inspect & Adapt · Short, Regular, Purposeful

g.text: returning customers can see their last order and reorder it in one tap
oldest items first, right to left
